reviews.review: Become the true lore accurate Space Marine that you allwaays dreamed.

First of all, I'm a big fan of Warhammer 40k setting, tabletop games and PC strategy games; I LOVED the possibility of playing in an action game based in this universe: being a Space Marine, saving Imperial Guardsmen, meeting Inquisitors and defeating Chaos.
I hoped it was good. I WANTED it to be good.

...however, this game is AWFUL.

What we've got here is a boring, linear, repetitive third person action/shooter game. Every area is structured as an "arena" where you'll fight endless hordes of Orks (with a little variation in the last hours) with no strategy, timing or ability involved. 
Again and again. And again.
These fights will be EXTREMELY easy, except for some difficulty spikes thrown randomly into the game. When you die you never feel like it was your fault, nor you feel to improve your abilities when you defeat 10 or 15 'Ard Boyz.

Then there's the setting. Every ambient has no details and is identical to the one before and to the next one, meaning you'll be frequently lost and looking for an exit. There's no map, but don't worry: once you've reached an area you won't be able to go back to the previous one, meaning that exploration is absolutely useless. Moreover, you don't get any strategic benefit from the environment, except for some explosive barrels or crates of ammo & granades once in a while, so why bother?

In the end, this game was a huge disappointment for me. Go buy it ONLY if you know and love Warhammer 40k lore and the only thing you want to do for the next 15 hours is press X on your controller. Over and over again.

[b]Warhammer 40 000: Space Marine[/b] is a very good game for both, fans of the subject as well as the layman who will meet with the Games Workshop created the world for the first time. Rough, addictive action heavily sprinkled with the blood of enemies, surrounded by excellent audiovisual binding, makes a very good impression. It is a pity that the game in the end, at least in the single player mode is very limited and short, which affects its final evaluation. Hopefully Relic drew the conclusions may form another part of the game, which would be much longer and would give us a greater sense of freedom. Perhaps then we will see a real "game of the year".
this is such a great game, Get on it!!!!
